item.description:
Search everything in a project

  • A search box in the top bar, next to Sync. Type and the task list filters as you go.
  • It looks everywhere in the selected project — task names, people, status, dates, costs, notes, links, payment descriptions and amounts, and attachment file names.
  • Capital letters and accents do not matter. Typing βαγγελ finds Βαγγέλης.
  • Matches are highlighted in Harmony's gold, in both the task list and the task details on the right. When a match is somewhere the list cannot show — inside a payment note, say — the task gains a short line telling you where it was found.
  • Press Escape or click the ✕ to clear the search.

Also in this build: update dialogs now show the build number alongside the version, and buttons in them use Harmony's own colour.
